about.lead: What this site is, where the information comes from, and how to help.
about.purpose: Better Ternate is a volunteer-run guide that organizes local government information by what people need to do, like getting a barangay clearance or finding an emergency number, in English and Filipino.
about.official: For official transactions and announcements, always go to the municipality directly:
about.officialHall: The Ternate Municipal Hall and your barangay hall, in person
about.officialPending: Links to the municipality's own website and social media pages will be added here once volunteers verify them.
about.sources: Information is compiled by volunteers from public sources. Records marked “Sample data” are placeholders and must not be relied on.
about.sourcePsgc: Barangay names and codes: Philippine Standard Geographic Code (PSGC)
about.sourceVolunteers: Services, offices and hotlines: volunteer research, to be checked against official sources
about.contribute: Anyone can suggest a correction or add information. Content lives in plain files on GitHub and changes are reviewed before they go live.
about.privacyIntro: We follow the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173) and collect as little as possible.
about.privacyStorage: Your language and theme choices are saved only in your own browser. We use no tracking cookies or ads.
about.privacyForms: If you send us a message or feedback, we keep only what you submit, use it only to respond or fix the site, and delete it when no longer needed.
about.privacyThirdParty: The map loads tiles from OpenStreetMap, which can see your IP address.
about.privacyRights: You may ask to access, correct or delete information you sent us through the contact page.
